@graph.name: EndoTag AP-MS Profiling of Chromatin Modifier Interactome Rewiring in MDA-MB-468 Cells Upon Paclitaxel Perturbation
@graph.description: This submission comprises affinity purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS) raw data generated from endogenously tagged MDA-MB-468 cells under Paclitaxel perturbation. The dataset focuses on drug-induced interactome rewiring of chromatin modifiers relevant to the triple-negative breast cancer context. All AP-MS experiments were performed in four biological replicates. Each AP-MS batch includes an untagged parental control, 10 chromatin modifier tagged cell lines, and a positive control tagged line. DMSO-treated samples serve as vehicle control across all AP-MS experiments (Unpublished data).
